citations.cites: E-22 - Damage to metal roof surfacing consisting solely of denting, without loss of water-shedding function
E-21 - Cosmetic damage to roof surfacing caused by hail, exception requires water intrusion

facts: 2024-09-03 Hail dented the metal roof panels; the roofer finds no leaks and the panels still shed water.
2024-09-05 Insured wants the whole roof replaced. Estimate 16,800.
note: The hail event caused denting of the metal roof panels, which under HO-0415 E-22 is excluded when there is no loss of water-shedding function. Additionally, the cosmetic damage exclusion E-21 does not apply because there was no water intrusion within 30 days. [HO-0415_01-24#05] [HO-0415_01-24#05]
